location_exception_reason: Portable kitchens are prefabricated structures sold as complete units; location of manufacture or deployment does not change the product's functional identity or buyer decision-making. GI-tagged or regional-origin claims do not apply.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') are redundant in titles — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Portable Kitchen Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title; the business relationship is not part of what is being sold.
